description.it: Scadenze e ingaggi della rosa del club scelto.
description.en: Contract expiries and wages of the chosen club.

widgets.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM contracts WHERE club_uid = :club AND "end" <= date(:today, '+' || :months || ' months')
SELECT sum(wage) AS value FROM contracts WHERE club_uid = :club
SELECT max(wage) AS value FROM contracts WHERE club_uid = :club
SELECT player_name, wage FROM contracts WHERE club_uid = :club AND wage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wage DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT substr("end", 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS contracts FROM contracts WHERE club_uid = :club AND "end" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT c.player_name, p.age, p.ability_current, c.wage, c."end" AS contract_end, c.squad_status, p.transfer_value FROM contracts c LEFT JOIN players p ON p.uid = c.player_uid WHERE c.club_uid = :club AND c."end" <= date(:today, '+' || :months_list || ' months') ORDER BY c."end"
